shortBio.en: Rolling Stones rhythm/lead guitar; open-G and five-string approaches on many 1970s tracks.
shortBio.zh: Rolling Stones 节奏/主音吉他；1970 年代大量曲目用 open-G 与五弦奏法。

body.en:
Born 1943, Dartford. Co-founder and principal guitar with Mick Jagger. Open-G tuning and five-string setups appear on many mid-period Stones records.

Rhythm parts lock with Watts; lead breaks share space with Wood or Taylor depending on era.
body.zh:
1943 年生于 Dartford。与 Mick Jagger 共同创办，主责吉他。中期大量唱片使用 open-G 与五弦设置。

节奏与 Watts 咬合；独奏段落视年代与 Wood 或 Taylor 分担。
